newsitem.title: UK: BA Cargo 9mth revenues 429 mln stg, up 1 pct.
newsitem.headline: BA Cargo 9mth revenues 429 mln stg, up 1 pct.

text.p: British Airways World Cargo said revenues rose one percent to 429 million stg for the nine months to end-December last year, compared to the same 1995 period.
However total revenues for freight, mail and courier traffic in the third quarter were 145 million stg, down 2.5 percent, it added in a statement.

Kevin Hatton, managing director World Cargo said: "The industry continued to witness the effects of over-capacity on yields in the third quarters against a backdrop of sluggish world growth. This is reflected in our figures and those of our competitors."

Despite the industry downturn, World Cargo achieved a number of important successes during the quarter. Fresh produce handled at its perishables centre at Heathrow grew by 58 percent in December with record tonnage of fruits and vegetables, the statement added.
Freighter services using outsourced and joint-venture capacity, saw a 15 percent increased in volume, with Tokyo, Gothenburg/Helsinki and Seoul routes particularly strong.

The relocation of all Pacific freight to a dedicated facility at Heathrow airport helped service levels improve for customers moving cargo to and from the region. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
